title: Complete 10-Screen UI/UX Bento Redesign & Ergonomics (v0.4.8)
message: Full ergonomic and visual modernization across student library, reader, and teacher administrative suites with Bento design, sticky blur headers, and streamlined workflows.
changelog:
• Ergonomic Class Management: Eliminated bottom-stacked action buttons in Class Detail, introducing a 3-tile Bento Quick Actions Hub for instant access to Performance Analytics, Weekly Assessments, and Initiation Settings, leaving a single thumb-reachable '+ Generate Student Accounts' floating dock.
• Immersive PDF Reader: Redesigned PDF Viewer with floating frosted HUD, live reading page indicator, and floating thumb-reach quiz launch dock.
• Full Bento Library Suite: Modernized LibraryActivity, StudentSubjectActivity, TeacherLibraryActivity, and SubjectDetailActivity with Aurora mesh canvas, sticky FastBlurView headers, squircle monogram avatars, and zero-elevation Bento document cards.
• Enhanced Quiz & Assessment Suite: Upgraded QuizEditorActivity and TeacherPerformanceActivity with Bento question cards, reordering controls, accuracy benchmark tiles, and cascade spring animations.
